output.reason: [ev-628f9c0eccb2] says Strimzi removed support for ZooKeeper-based Apache Kafka clusters and for KRaft migration. So the thing that changed is Strimzi's interaction with another product, ZooKeeper, and that interaction no longer exists. A product-relationship subject named "zookeeper" with change type "removed" matches this. Neither the subject nor the change is a version-requirement shift or a rename.
